REQUIRED-GENERIC-OPEN: Most domains will never receive a dedicated site profile, so the default path must remain useful.

REQUIRED-GENERIC-BODY: Semantic containers, text density, link density, and conservative retry behavior provide a strong portable baseline.

> A profile can improve a known layout, but it must not become a prerequisite for readable output.

REQUIRED-GENERIC-END: The E2E suite guards both configured sites and this unconfigured path.
